# Where AI Pays Off {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Pick the right work to hand over

## The Bottleneck Test

Hand a task to AI when it is:

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**✅ Good fit**

- **Repetitive & mundane** — status reports, routine emails
- **Data-intensive** — summarizing, finding patterns
- **Drafting & brainstorming** — beating the blank page
- **Predictable** — clear, logical steps
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**⚠️ Keep a human in the loop**

- **High-stakes** — money, safety, big consequences
- **Deeply human** — empathy, hard conversations
- **Confidential** — sensitive or personal data
- **Originality is the point** — a truly unique take
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; font-weight: bold; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
The "Good fit" column is exactly what belongs on your backlog.
:::

# Build: Your Automation Backlog {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

The list we'll work from all week

## List the Work That Eats Your Week

::: {style="font-size: 1.1em; margin-bottom: 0.8em;"}
Write down **3–5 recurring tasks** that pass the Bottleneck Test.
:::

::: {.incremental}
- For each, note **how often** (per week) and **minutes each time**
- That's your **Time Log** — current cost, *before* AI
- Every build session, you'll pull one task from this list and automate it
- In the finale we total the minutes saved → **hours won back per week**
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {.callout-tip}
## Worksheet
Use `prompts/automation_backlog_and_time_log.md`. Keep it open all week.
:::
:::

## Two Rules We Never Break {auto-animate=true}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #1C355E;"}
**Newspaper Test**

Guards what you *paste **in***. Sanitize confidential or personal data first.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**Blast Radius**

Guards what the agent ***does***. Start in draft / notify-me mode.
:::
:::
::::

. . .

::: {style="text-align: center; color: #666; font-size: 0.9em; margin-top: 0.5em;"}
We'll meet rule 1 today and rule 2 on Day 2 — and all hands-on work runs in a **sandbox**.
:::

## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **AI is a teammate, not a search engine** — we automate work, not look things up
2. **Automate the right work** — repetitive, data-heavy, drafting, predictable
3. **Your backlog is the target** — we automate it over the next three days
4. **Everything is measured** — the Time Log becomes your ROI in the finale
:::
